finding: Assumption Register links directly to source_ids although the governing traceability chain requires SOURCE → EVIDENCE → ASSUMPTION.
recommended_action: Add evidence_ids to assumptions and use evidence claims as the decision basis; retain source_ids only as optional convenience.
verification_method: Schema inspection plus sample trace from ASM to EVD
notes: Verified: assumptions.csv now has evidence_ids and load-bearing seeded assumptions point to claim-level EVD records; source_ids remain convenience only.

finding: Evidence records lack an exact source locator, so a claim can point to a document/site without identifying page, section, timestamp or exact help article location.
recommended_action: Add source_locator and claim_type to Evidence Register; add source publication/version fields to Source Register.
notes: Verified: all inherited evidence ranges now include source_locator and claim_type; sources.csv includes publication/version/archive fields. Unverified external claims explicitly use PENDING_A2_EXACT_LOCATOR and cannot become SUPPORTED until A2 populates an exact locator.

finding: Contradiction Register points to raw source IDs rather than the conflicting evidence claims, making it unclear exactly which assertions conflict.
recommended_action: Add evidence_a_id and evidence_b_id and require contradictions to be claim-to-claim.
verification_method: Trace CON-0001 to two explicit EVD records
notes: Verified: CON-0001 now links EVD-0179 against EVD-0004.

finding: Source verification statuses and terminology statuses are used but not defined in the P1.0 control specification.
recommended_action: Define Source and Terminology status vocabularies explicitly.
notes: Verified in P1_0_CONTROL_SYSTEM_V0_1.md: Source and Terminology status vocabularies are explicit.

verification_method: Vocabulary comparison and sample requirement audit
notes: Verified: requirement scope is explicitly separate from P1.1 product-area scope; current requirements use CROSS_CUTTING_CONSTRAINT.

affected_ids: EVD-0023; EVD-0026; similar composite inherited rows
recommended_action: Preserve inherited parent IDs for historical traceability but prohibit composite/qualitative parent claims from directly supporting ADRs or requirements unless all components are independently verified; create child EVD claims when a component becomes load-bearing.
verification_method: Review first 25 dispositions and verify composite claims are contested/scoped or decomposed before downstream decision use
notes: Verified: control v0.2 retains atomicity for load-bearing claims but prevents universal atomization from expanding P1.0 unnecessarily.

finding: Audit Protocol v1.0 turned all 164 inherited competitor claims into a P1.0 verification queue even though the frozen roadmap places contractor evidence before competitor reconstruction.
recommended_action: Replace exhaustive claim verification with decision-leverage classification and targeted exact/grouped verification; defer non-load-bearing competitor detail to P1.3.
verification_method: Inspect Control v0.2, Audit Protocol v1.1 and decision-leverage classification
notes: Verified: CHG-0002 implemented. All 164 claims remain controlled but only decision-leveraged evidence creates P1.0 verification work.

finding: Progress was measured by inherited claim count/document order rather than by whether evidence constrained architecture decisions.
recommended_action: Seed ADR decision targets and classify evidence by whether flipping it can change a decision; retire 82/164 as a gate trigger.
verification_method: Verify ADR-0003 through ADR-0023 exist and CP-04 trigger no longer references 50% claim count
notes: Verified: ADR register now contains explicit decision stubs and P1.0 protocol measures decision coverage rather than corpus completion.

finding: Incumbent vocabulary could become canonical terminology before P1.2 primary contractor evidence, defeating the roadmap's reality-before-incumbents protection.
recommended_action: Make current domain terms provisional working labels; derive canonical vocabulary primary-first in P1.2; map competitor terms as attributed synonyms in P1.3.

notes: Verified: current terms remain PROVISIONAL and explicitly cannot seed canonical ontology before P1.2.

notes: Verified: CP-05 package now explicitly requires actual repository artifacts; narrative-only summaries are insufficient.
